recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Do not restore the old core ConceptMap or CDS-on-FHIR mapping table unless the CDS work group reverses FHIR-53085; future mapping corrections should be made in the CDS Hooks Clinical Reasoning IG or THO as appropriate.
issue_request: FHIR-15750 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by the CDS work group. It requested a way to represent CDS Hooks indicator values in FHIR and a bidirectional mapping between CDS Hooks Response.indicator and FHIR Request priority.
initial_application: Historical GF#15750 commits eddc29460b and 8445a21031 added the CDS Hooks indicator CodeSystem and ValueSet, source/conceptmap/conceptmap-cdshooks-indicator.xml, a ConceptMap spreadsheet entry, and a CDS-on-FHIR page link from Response.indicator to conceptmap-cdshooks-indicator.html.
additional_context: FHIR-19786 later retired the core CDS Hooks indicator terminology in favor of THO. FHIR-53085 then moved most CDS-on-FHIR page content and the CDS Hooks mapping ConceptMaps to the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG. Related Applied issues FHIR-52870 and FHIR-48308 were applied in that IG by commit 61bbc5e8933a1eed0012f8efe7b6627172a687d8, which added the indicator-to-request-priority ConceptMap with CodeSystem source and target URIs.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source keeps the CDS-on-FHIR page in the Clinical Reasoning build, points readers to the external IG, no longer contains the old core ConceptMap source, and retains only retired/deprecated core terminology artifacts with a THO successor pointer.

related_jiras.note: Retired the core CDS Hooks indicator terminology in favor of THO, explaining why core is no longer the active terminology home.
Moved CDS-on-FHIR content and the CDS Hooks mapping ConceptMaps from core into the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG.
Clarified that the CDS Hooks Indicator to Request Priority ConceptMap is normative mapping content owned by CDS, but it was applied in the external IG.
Required the indicator ConceptMap to specify source and target CodeSystem URIs, and was applied in the external IG.
